SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign reading 3.2.2 Introduction of syllables (ba - bu, da- du), part of Strand 3 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: Where can we read letter sounds from in and out of school? 2. Where can we sign read letter sounds from in and out of school?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign reading 3.2.2 Introduction of syllables (ba - bu, da- du) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• communication and collaboration: signing skills as learner gains confidence in reading syllables.

• Learning to learn: Self-discipline as learner learns to join sounds to make syllables.

Values:
● Love: Hospitability as learner with the others in class correct each other positively as they make syllables.

● Responsibility: Hardwork as learners peer teach one another on how to read syllables.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Social cohesion as learner works harmoniously with others to achieve a common goal in reading syllables.

Link to other Activity Areas:

Learner relates how they sign read letter sounds with how they read numbers from charts, writing boards, books in

Mathematic Activities.
